ex: He couldn't outrun his pursuers.
他跑不过追他的人。

en: very unusual in a way that sometimes shocks
to sell more or to be sold in larger quantities than somebody/something
ex: We are now outselling all our competitors.
我们现在比所有竞争对手都卖得多。

zh: 比…做得好；使逊色；高人一筹
en: to be more impressive than somebody/something; to be better than somebody/something
ex: He far outshone the rest of the class.
他远远超出了班上其他同学。

en: not in a room, building or container but on or to the outside of it
ex: I'm seeing a patient—please wait outside.
我正在给病人看病，请在外面等候。

zh: 实地拍摄的节目；现场录制的节目
en: a programme filmed or recorded away from the main studio

zh: （高速公路等靠近路中心的）外车道，超车道
en: the part of a major road such as a motorway or interstate nearest the middle of the road, where vehicles drive fastest and can go past vehicles ahead

zh: （比赛中）不被看好的人（或动物）
en: a person who is not accepted as a member of a society, group, etc.
ex: Here she felt she would always be an outsider.
她在这里总觉得是个外人。

zh: 较大的；超过一般型号的
en: larger than the usual size
ex: an outsize desk
一张特大号桌子

en: the parts of a town or city that are furthest from the centre
ex: They live on the outskirts of Milan.
他们住在米兰市郊。
